name: Chaos Reference Pack
author: vineyard-run
description: A bundle of 6 graph-manipulation plugins for demo/validation: Korean Roulette, Russian Roulette, Thanos Snap, Black Hole, Dumb AI Optimizer, Schrödinger's Node. Installing once adds all 6 together.

name: IP to ASN (Team Cymru - DoH Based)
author: vineyard-run
description: Enriches IP Address nodes with their announcing AS (number + name) and country, via Team Cymru over DNS-over-HTTPS. No server required.

name: CDN / WAF Detection (cdncheck)
author: vineyard-run
description: Matches IPs against known CDN/WAF edge ranges offline and domains against CDN CNAME patterns via DNS-over-HTTPS, using ProjectDiscovery's cdncheck dataset.

name: Domain Recon
author: vineyard-run
description: Passive, keyless domain enrichment: per-record DNS lookups over DoH (A, AAAA, CNAME, MX, NS, TXT, CAA), RDAP registration data, and Certificate Transparency subdomain discovery. No API keys, no server.

name: IP Recon
author: vineyard-run
description: Passive, keyless IP enrichment: RDAP allocation/ownership, Shodan InternetDB exposure (open ports, CVEs, hostnames), and approximate geolocation. Runs entirely in the browser — no API keys, no server.

name: Image OSINT
author: vineyard-run
description: Browser-only image tools: reverse-image-search lead generation (Google Lens / Yandex / Bing / TinEye) and local EXIF/GPS extraction. No API keys, no server, and images never leave your machine.

name: CTI Pivot
author: vineyard-run
description: Infrastructure attribution for CTI: cluster nodes by shared registrar / nameserver / ASN / TLS certificate and link them, revealing which entities likely belong to the same operator. Pure graph analysis — no network, no keys.

name: WhatsMyName
author: vineyard-run
description: Checks whether a handle or username exists across roughly 700 sites using the WhatsMyName dataset, adding a Handle node plus one User Account per site found. Desktop only: a browser cannot read the cross-origin responses these checks need.

name: Xeuledoc
author: vineyard-run
description: Reads the public metadata of link-shared Google Drive documents: owner name, email, account id, timestamps and sharing role. A GPL-3.0 port of xeuledoc by Malfrats Industries. Desktop only — the request must carry no Origin header.

name: Wayback Machine
author: vineyard-run
description: Queries the Internet Archive Wayback Machine for the selected domain or URL: capture history via the CDX API, and a closest-snapshot check via the Availability API. Desktop only — the archive sends no CORS headers.

name: Disposable Email
author: vineyard-run
description: Checks whether the selected email address belongs to a known disposable-email domain (74k+ domain blocklist, subdomain-aware), and sets the node's is_disposable flag to true or false.
